extracted.intended_audience: general public; banquet and society attendees; readers of Mark Twain's speeches
extracted.subtask_description: Transcripts of Mark Twain's humorous addresses delivered at dinners, banquets, university convocations, and society events; intended to entertain, satirize, and comment on social/political topics. Useful as examples of early-20th-century American comic oratory and public lecturing style.
